attempts.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.
Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: L21 busan_breakwater_flashback/key.png final full-size 1536x1024 landscape PNG. Recipe: establish. SAME NECK geography on the NIGHT OF THE OPENING, TEN YEARS AGO, chapter35 memory.
NECK VIEW CAMERA LOCK: high oblique camera about 18 m above the exposed sea, looking landward diagonally along the breakwater, horizon at the upper fifth. Composition: bottom-left foreground is the 6 m walkway; it recedes diagonally to the central neck at picture centre and then turns to the market's sea-wall pier at upper left. Continuous low seaward parapet follows the walkway's RIGHT edge; grey tetrapods below it occupy the LOWER-RIGHT; exposed open sea fills the RIGHT half. Sheltered harbour basin and small moored boats are LEFT of the walkway. Market roof, orange tent, sea wall and concrete pier are at UPPER-LEFT, visually about 200 m behind the central neck. A 25 m steel lattice harbour light tower stands on that pier at left of centre, with a ladder and square floodlight platform. It rises ABOVE this 18 m camera's horizon: the platform is much higher than the low market roof. Keep the fixed buildings, shore shape and tower in these positions in each neck view. The lighthouse is 800 m seaward, behind the camera and OUT OF FRAME. Concrete walkway no stairs, no highway; the old round storm-drain outlet is low in the seaward masonry near the neck.
Fixed buildings: broad single-storey fish-market warehouse at upper-left with low corrugated roof; plain food tarp near the harbour edge (GREY, no orange); concrete pier and sea wall roughly200m behind the neck; 25m lattice harbour floodlight tower left of centre, high above roof and horizon. Long6m walkway, low0.9m parapet on seaward right, grey car-sized tetrapods lower-right, sheltered harbour with boats left, open sea right. Lighthouse 800m seaward behind camera, OUT OF FRAME. Same shore shape, central curve, perspective, tower placement and depths as the regular neck. One kilometre breakwater overall.
STRICT FLASHBACK COLOUR: architecture, sky, land, people, clothing, boats, flames, smoke and artificial lamps are entirely neutral GREYS, white and charcoal. Only the BOILING SEA AND GATE LIGHT have muted HUSH VIOLET. No orange tent, no orange/red fire, no yellow bulbs, no blue sky, no warm highlights. No amber figures in this environment-only key. Named KEY LIGHT: violet light emitted from the boiling sea on the right, restricted violet reflections at the water's edge. A cold pale-grey floodlight on the lattice tower gives crisp white highlights. Charcoal shadow masses, soft memory edges only in distant skyline, clean ink on foreground. No whole-image glow or haze.
The sea on the right heaves and boils violet, hard inked foam curls and rising white-violet spray. Far offshore near the upper-right horizon, a narrow distant COLUMN OF VIOLET GATE LIGHT rises from the sea, a subtle ominous source, not a giant ring in the sky. In the LEFT sheltered harbour, two small fishing boats are burning: angular WHITE AND GREY flame shapes and clumped charcoal smoke rising directly from their decks, attached to visible burning boats. No colored flames. A third boat sits at mooring nearby. Fifteen or so tiny generic civilians and dock workers flee from the central landward neck across the pier into the market at back-left, staggered depths, leaning forward mid-run with adult long legs and weight over feet. They are small scale figures, all grey, no legible faces or cast, no lineup, no chibi. About two nearest still tiny figures on the distant pier are clearly proportioned1.7m adults against the3m market roof and25m tower; the rest shrink with perspective. Foreground walkway mostly empty and intact, no monsters or crawler swarm, no giant boss, no named Geum or Operator, no visible Operator face, no amber light-fighters, no modern uniforms, no navy ships, no barge. Violet-only boiling sea, grey burning boats and crowd retreat are the event.
Rendering matches approved ink and cel references, which provide house technique only; do not depict either reference's character or setting. Large opaque shadows on matte stone and clear drawn contours. No photographic background or CG tetrapods.
No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
